dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: I didn't know that you two were so good at beetle battles!

choices.text: That's right, I've always been a master beetle battler.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even so, it was usually Bull-Chucker dragging us into it...

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: This really is an interesting form of recreation! If I do get the chance to play it in Inazuma, I'd like to try the original form.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds good! We've got lots of friends in Inazuma, too, so when you get there, we can get everyone together. We'll have a blast!

choices.text: We didn't expect you to be a mechanical expert either...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, and you're even teaching others now. You must've learned all kinds of skills by now, huh?

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: I wouldn't say so... Really, I've just been learning the fundamentals from Master...

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: She doesn't live in seclusion anymore these days, nor does she intend to have me live that way.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: That's why she's taught me two sets of mechanical arts — one adeptal, and the other mortal.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: She said that I could make a good living for myself using normal mechanical arts, should I want to live in Liyue Harbor in the future.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: And that won't get in the way of my continued study of adeptal mechanical arts, either.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That makes a lot of sense. Wow, she really does think of everything, huh...

choices.text: Would you like to find a job, Shuyu?

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: I... I don't know yet. Right now, I'd prefer to stay by Master's side.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: But if she needs Mora, I'll help her make some!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't think she'd ever need Mora. Even her smallest inventions could sell for crazy amounts in Liyue Harbor...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: She's probably even wealthier than a certain "consultant" we know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, he's an exception. There's no point in talking common sense with him.

choices.text: Want to make the big Mora, Shuyu?
Let's have a good beetle battle next time!

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Ah, I guess you've got other things to do, right? In that case, I'll see you around!
